title: Obstructions to Deformation Quantization of Bundles
abstract: Let $\left(M, \mathcal{O}_M \right)$ be a smooth algebraic variety over field $κ$ of characteristic $0$ with an algebraic symplectic form $ω$, or a complex manifold with a holomorphic form $ω$. Furthermore, let $E$ be a vector bundle over $\left(M, \mathcal{O}_M \right)$ and $\mathcal{O}_{\hbar}$ a deformation quantization of $\mathcal{O}_M$ compatible with $ω$.   Assuming that $E$ possesses a deformation quantization to order $\hbar^k$ we consider the problem of extending it to order $\hbar^\ell$ for $\ell > k$, and establish triviality of an obstruction class as a necessary condition for this extension to exist. Furthermore, in the case $\ell \le 2k+1$, we prove that this condition is also sufficient.
summary: This paper tackles the deep mathematical problem of extending an existing low-order deformation quantization of a vector bundle to higher orders. It establishes that the existence of such extensions is governed by the vanishing of specific cohomology obstruction classes derived from analyzing the underlying algebraic and geometric structures.
main_problem: The central problem is determining the cohomological obstructions that govern whether an existing order $k$ deformation quantization of a vector bundle can be extended to a higher order $\ell$. This involves analyzing how algebraic structures defined by symplectic forms behave under formal power series expansions.
main_result: For certain regimes ($\ell \le 2k+1$), the obstruction class in specific cohomology groups ($H^2$) is both necessary and sufficient for the extension to exist. For higher orders, vanishing of the obstruction is only proven to be a necessary condition.
method: The authors employ advanced techniques from algebraic geometry and deformation theory, utilizing sheaf cohomology ($H^i(M, 	ext{End}(E)^{(k, \ell]})$) and relating these obstructions to Lie algebra extensions via concepts like Harish-Chandra pairs and the Gelfand-Fuchs map.
model_or_system: The mathematical model is the deformation quantization of a vector bundle $E$ over a smooth algebraic variety $(M, \omega)$ equipped with an algebraic symplectic form. The structure is formalized using formal power series algebras $\mathcal{O}_\hbar$.
key_observables: Obstruction classes residing in cohomology groups like $H^2(M, 	ext{End}(E)^{(k, \ell]})$ or $	ext{Ext}^1_{\mathcal{O}_\hbar}(\dots)$.
important_parameters: The orders of quantization ($k$ and $\ell$) relative to each other ($\ell > k$), and the characteristic zero nature of the base field $\kappa$.
main_assumptions: The existence of a symplectic form $\omega$ on $M$, and local analysis relying on formal Darboux lemmas or jet bundle constructions.
paper_structure: The paper progresses by first establishing the necessary and sufficient conditions for extension in specific regimes ($\ell \le 2k+1$), then analyzing the structure of obstructions using Lie algebra cohomology, and finally addressing the more complex case $\ell \ge 2k+2$ where only necessity is proven.
why_interesting: While highly abstract, this work provides rigorous mathematical tools for understanding how quantum corrections (quantization) can be consistently built up order-by-order in a physical theory defined on a curved background manifold.
